# Ciprovet

The most complete and practical solution for complicated ulcers

  * Ophthalmic
  * Cats
  * Dogs

Ciprovet, broad spectrum antibiotic eye drops and therapeutic margin. Contains Ciprofloxacin in a 20% Chondroitin Sulfate base.

A higher frequency of superficial ulcers and ocular pathologies in the anterior segment justifies the choice of this eye drop.

Ciprovet achieves excellent concentration and maximum antibiotic permanence at this level, promoting quick healing and avoiding further complications.

Image: Ciprovet packagingThis presentation corresponds to the Global portfolio, it may vary according to your country of residence.

## How does Ciprovet works?

  * ### Ciprofloxacin

Ciprofloxacin belongs to the group of fluoroquinolones and is notable for its action on many bacterial groups.

  * ### Chondroitin Sulfate

Chondroitin Sulfate stimulates and organizes corneal repair, improves healing and preserves natural moisturization and transparency of the surface.

## Indication

  * Bacterial conjunctivitis, tear deficit, contaminated dry keratitis and corneal ulcers caused by susceptible microorganisms, lesions and/or infections in the anterior chamber.
  * Especially indicated against infections caused by Pseudomona aeruginosa, the bacteria responsible for most ulcerative processes of the cornea or their complications.

## Dosage and administration

Instill one drop of Ciprovet in the affected eye every 24 hours. In case of severe ocular infection or corneal ulcers, start the treatment with one drop every 12 hours and continue every 24 hours or according to the criteria of the Veterinarian.

## Formula

Each 1 ml of product contains:

Chondroitin Sulfate 200.0 mg, Ciprofloxacin 3.0 mg, Carrier q.s. 1 ml.

# Tau Ophthalmic

In-depth action for complicated conjunctivitis

  * Ophthalmic
  * Cats
  * Dogs

Tau Ophthalmic, broad spectrum antibiotic eye drops with excellent intraocular penetration, combines Chloramphenicol in an excipient that guarantees maximum permanence of the antibiotic on the ocular surface, reducing evaporation of the tear film. Chloramphenicol spectrum is effective even against intracellular bacteria.

Image: Tau Ophthalmic packagingThis presentation corresponds to the Global portfolio, it may vary according to your country of residence.

## Indication

  * Due to its high antibacterial efficacy, it is indicated in general infectious processes, blepharitis, keratitis, anterior chamber infections, wounds and irritations of the conjunctiva and eyelids.
  * Conjunctivitis of various origins, especially those caused by Chlamidya spp.
  * Also indicated in perioperative prophylaxis.

## Dosage and administration

Instill one drop of Tau Ophthalmic in the affected eye, every 8 hours.

## Formula

Each 1 ml of product contains:

Cloranfenicol 10,0 mg, Benzocaína 20 mg, Excipientes c.s.p. 1 ml.

# Avaliaçao do uso tópico de sulfato de condroitina a (ciprovet) no tratamento de úlcera de cornea experimental em coehlos

## 

Pretendeu-se avaliar a eficácia do Sulfato de Condoitrina A como tratamento de úlceras de córnea experimentais em coelhos, analisando-se seu potencial antiinflamatorio, além da reduçao de tecido cicatricial. Utilizaram-se 15 coelhos, divididos em tratados e não tratados, subdivididos em 3 grupos de 5 animaes cada, sacrificados no 7o., 14o. e 30o dia após a ceratectomia.

dezembro 4, 2017 6:29 pm

Esta, do tipo lamelar, foi feita em ambos os olhos, sendo un deles tratados com Ciprovet colírio (sulfato de condoitrina A e ciprofloxacina associados) e o contralateral, como controle, com colírio de Ciprofloxacina. Os olhos foram avaliados quanto aos sinais clínicos bem como suas córneas, em exame histopatológico. Quanto aos sinais, verificou-se hiperemia de conjuntiva e blefarospasmo nos dois primeiros dias e teste de fluoresceína positivo até no máximo o 5o. dia. Não se observou diferença quanto aos sinais clínicos entre os grupos tratados e nãp tratados.

# Ocubiotic

The solution for serious and painful eye infections

  * Ophthalmic
  * Cats
  * Dogs

Ocubiotic eye drops with triple antibiotic effect. Standing out for the broad bactericidal spectrum of its antibiotics – Neomycin, Polymyxin B and Bacitracin Zn – and their synergistic action. With analgesic effect, it prevents self-inflicted injuries due to scratching. Its excipient retains moisture, allowing better diffusion and persistence of the active principles on the ocular surface, and providing greater comfort to the patient. Indicated for use in canines, felines and equines.

Image: Ocubiotic packagingThis presentation corresponds to the Global portfolio, it may vary according to your country of residence.

## Indication

  * Infectious processes with maximum antibacterial spectrum, thanks to the bactericidal and synergistic action of its 3 antibiotics.
  * The low concentration of Benzocaine is enough to provide analgesia.
  * Ideal as a first indication, prior to cultivation and sensitivity studies.
  * Indicated in general infectious processes, blepharitis, keratitis, conjunctivitis, wounds and irritations of conjunctiva and eyelids.

## Dosage and administration

Instill one drop of Ocubiotic in the affected eye every 6-8 hours. Treatment duration according to professional discretion.
